About the Project

This was a group economic assessment project with Emma, Jonas, and Chris. We conducted a full analysis of Argentina's economic landscape — one of the most complex and volatile in the world — covering inflation history, currency policy, debt restructuring, agricultural exports, and the political factors shaping economic decisions.
